foundation.framingA.title: Uyu ndi msonkhano wathu woyamba.
foundation.framingA.body:
Mafunso asanu ndi awiri abata — koma mutha kuima mutatha atatu ndikuwona kuwerenga kwanu koyamba.

Palibe mayankho olondola. Zowona zimaposa zodabwitsa.
Izi si zoyeserera. Ndi chithunzi choyamba cha komwe muli pakali pano, kuti ndikumane nanu kumeneko.
foundation.framingA.skip: Dumpha pakali pano — gwiritsani ntchito zokhazikika
foundation.framingB.title: Awa ndi maziko anu.
foundation.framingB.body:
Zomwe mwandipatsa posachedwapa zikukhala gulu lanu loyambira.

M'masiku otsatira ndipitiriza kusintha — izi si zoyeserera, ndi chithunzi choyamba.
foundation.qcard.skipAhead: Dumphira patsogolo — onetsani kuwerenga kwanga tsopano
foundation.q1.title: Ndi ziti mwa njirazi zomwe zili zazikulu mwa inu pakali pano?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Mpaka 3. Khalani owona.
foundation.q1.opt3: Kuthawa — kusokoneza maganizo, kusuntha pazenera, kudzetsa dzanzi
foundation.q1.opt4: Kuda nkhawa — mantha omwewo, nkhani yomweyo, fundo yomweyo
foundation.q2.title: Kodi ndi liwiro liti la machitidwe omwe mungathe kupitiriza pakali pano?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Osati zolinga. Zomwe moyo wanu wamakono udzakupatsani.
foundation.q2.opt1: Wofatsa — mwambo umodzi wazing'ono, wosungika kwamuyaya
foundation.q2.opt2: Wapakati — machitidwe a tsiku ndi tsiku, olimba apakati
foundation.q2.opt3: Wamphamvu — ndikufuna tapas, ndikufuna kuti ziwotche
foundation.q2.opt4: Wamonaki — ndikufuna tsiku lalikulu mkati mwake
foundation.q3.title: Mukamalota za inu wabwino kwambiri, iwo ali...
foundation.q3.opt1: Womasuka — nthawi zonse akaphunzira, nthawi zonse akuyenda
foundation.q3.opt2: M'chikondi — atasungunuka mu china chake chachikulu
foundation.q3.opt4: Wanzeru — wata, womveka, ena amabwera kwa iwo
foundation.q3.opt5: Pakati pa dziko — kuona zomwe ena sangathe
foundation.q3.opt6: Kukhalapo kwabata komwe anthu amachirira pafupi
foundation.q3.opt8: Kupanga china chake chimene dziko silinachiwone
foundation.q4.title: Kodi khomo liti liri pafupi nanu pakali pano?
foundation.q4.opt6: Ntchito yamphamvu — kupuma, luso lamkati, moyo
foundation.q5.title: Kodi mukubwera kudzakonzanso chiyani pano?
foundation.q5.opt1: Chikhulupiriro chimene ndakhala nacho kuyambira ndili mwana
foundation.q5.opt3: Ubale wanga ndi ntchito ndi khama
foundation.q6.title: Kodi chiyani chimamveka chowona kwambiri?
foundation.q6.opt2: Ndili ndi chisankho pa momwe ndimayankhira
foundation.q7.title: Chinthu chovuta chikachitika, mumapita kuti choyamba?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Zindikirani kusuntha koyamba komweko.
foundation.q8.title: Kodi mumadziwa bwanji kuyang'ana malingaliro anu?
foundation.q8.opt4: Ndi gawo lokhazikika la moyo wanga
foundation.analysis.subtitle: Izi zidzasintha pamene mukuchita. Palibe chomwe chili chokhazikika - ndiye cholinga chake.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: Tidzawerenganso izi masiku angapo alionse. Magulu amasuntha. Ndiye cholinga chake.
foundation.brain.head.label: Mtsogoleri wamutu
foundation.brain.heart.label: Mtsogoleri wamtima
foundation.brain.gut.label: Kuyendera mudumbu
foundation.brain.head.line: Umaganira pakutanga. Ticharemekedza izvozvo, tobva tadzidzisa muviri kuti ubate.
foundation.brain.heart.line: Umanzwa pakutanga. Tichazvichengeta zvakashama, tobva tawedzerachapupu kuseri kwazvo.
foundation.brain.gut.line: Unotanga kufamba. Tichakunonotsa zvishoma kuti unzwe zviri pasi.
foundation.analysis.loopsEmpty: Hapana ruzha parizvino — tichazviwana tichiri kuita.
foundation.analysis.returnNote: Unogona kugara uchidzokera kuverenga kwako gare gare kubva kuZvirongwa. Hapana chakagadziriswa zvachose.
foundation.paths.title: Sarudza shamwari dzako.
foundation.paths.subtitle: Kutarisa ndiwo muvhe – nzira yese inotangira ipapo. Sarudza nzira dze2–3 dzinonzwika kuva dzipenyu kwauri ikozvino. Unogona kugara uchiwedzera zvimwe gare gare.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Kutarisa zviripo, pasina kubata kana kusunda. Nzira yese yatinofamba nayo pamwe chete inotangira pachigaro ichi.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Iyi ndiyo nzvimbo yako yekutangira – kwete keji. Nzira yako ichakura sekunakita kwako.
foundation.archetype.creator: Wolipidha
foundation.path.kriya.blurb: Ntchito yamphamvu kudzera mu mpweya ndi njira zamkati.
foundation.path.karma.blurb: Ntchito yopanda chidwi. Utumiki ngati pemphero.
foundation.path.jnana.blurb: Kufufuza. Kudula chinyengo ndi kumveketsa bwino.
foundation.path.dhyana.blurb: Kukhala chete. Kuzama kudzera mu bata.
